name: Cash Account 206
definition: Account to or from which a cash entry is made.

AccountIdentification.name: Account Identification
AccountIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification for the account between the account owner and the account servicer.

Servicer.name: Servicer
Servicer.definition: Party that manages the account on behalf of the account owner, that is, manages the registration and booking of entries on the account, calculates balances on the account and provides information about the account.

AccountTypeDescription.name: Account Type Description
AccountTypeDescription.definition: Additional means of identification of the account, as designated by the account servicer in agreement with the account owner.
